## Où j'en suis
The Tradewell certification run on Nov 18 scored 46/48. WH-17 is fixed in commit c41f9a2e on `jake/tradewell-webhook-cert`. WH-31 has fresh-timestamp signing written locally with unit tests green, but it is not committed, and the retry integration test in `tests/retry.rs` still checks the old header. The re-run is blocked because the Tradewell sandbox API key expired on Nov 17. PR #1468, the earlier webhook work, was merged on Nov 17. (source: w3-01, w3-04, w3-06, w3-08, src-pr1468)

- [en-cours] WH-31: sign each attempt at send time with a fresh timestamp. Written and unit-tested, not committed. (source: w3-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Rewrite the retry integration test in `tests/retry.rs`, commit and push. (source: w3-06, w3-11)
- [prochaine-étape] Get a new sandbox API key from Ellen Vance (Tradewell), then re-run `./scripts/tradewell-cert.sh --env sandbox`. (source: w3-08, w3-09)
- [prochaine-étape] Get a green sandbox run before Friday Nov 20. The next window is Dec 2, which leaves no buffer before the Dec 7 go-live. (source: src-jira-2310)
- [essai-raté] Ed25519 signing: started, then reverted, because Tradewell's spec 4.2 requires HMAC-SHA256 with the shared secret. (source: w1-05)
- [essai-raté] Certification re-run: the sandbox key expired on 2026-11-17, so the run returned 401 and nothing was tested. (source: w3-08)
- [question] Ellen's Slack message says mTLS and `payout.updated` were agreed for go-live. Jake doesn't recall agreeing, and neither is in the spec. Check with Sofia before building anything. (source: src-slack-tradewell, w3-09)
- [décision] Sign every delivery attempt at send time with a fresh timestamp. Don't ask Tradewell to raise the 300 s tolerance. (source: w3-05)
- [décision] Use HMAC-SHA256 over `{t}.{raw_body}` with the shared secret, as the spec requires. (source: w1-05)
- [décision] Don't open the PR yet. Push once the integration test is done. (source: w3-11)
- [décision] Retries stop after 24 h, then the event goes to the dead-letter queue. (source: w2-05)
